sections.shortTitle: Gilgit-Baltistan Council Anti-Money Laundering Adaptation Act 2014
sections.description:
Short title, extent, and commencement

ACT I OF 2014(sic
ACT I OF 2014(sic.)
GILGIT-BALTISTAN COUNCIL ANTI-MONEY
LAUNDERING (ADAPTATION) ACT, 2014
An Act to adapt and to enforce the
Anti-Money
Laundering Act, 2010 of Pakistan in Gilgit-Baltistan
[Gazette
of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I,
31st December, 2014]
No.
C-1(1)/2014 GBC, dated 31-12-2014.---The following Act, passed by the
Gilgit-Baltistan Council on 21st July, 2014 and authenticated by the Chairman,
Gilgit-Baltistan Council/Prime Minister of Pakistan, is hereby published for
general information.
WHEREAS
it is necessary to adapt and to enforce Anti-Money Laundering Act, 2010 (VII of
2010), as in force in Pakistan and to provide for matters connected therewith
or ancillary thereto;
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
1. Short
title, extent, and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the
Gilgit-Baltistan Council Anti-Money Laundering (Adaptation) Act, 2014.
(2) It
shall extend to the whole of Gilgit-Baltistan.
(3) It
shall come into force at once.

Adaptation of the Anti-Money Laundering Act, 2010 of Pakistan

ACT I OF 2014(sic
ACT I OF 2014(sic.)
GILGIT-BALTISTAN COUNCIL ANTI-MONEY
LAUNDERING (ADAPTATION) ACT, 2014
An Act to adapt and to enforce the
Anti-Money
Laundering Act, 2010 of Pakistan in Gilgit-Baltistan
[Gazette
of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I,
31st December, 2014]
No.
C-1(1)/2014 GBC, dated 31-12-2014.---The following Act, passed by the
Gilgit-Baltistan Council on 21st July, 2014 and authenticated by the Chairman,
Gilgit-Baltistan Council/Prime Minister of Pakistan, is hereby published for
general information.
WHEREAS
it is necessary to adapt and to enforce Anti-Money Laundering Act, 2010 (VII of
2010), as in force in Pakistan and to provide for matters connected therewith
or ancillary thereto;
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
3. Adaptation
of the Anti-Money Laundering Act, 2010 of Pakistan.---The Anti-Money
Laundering Act, 2010 (VII of 2010), and all rules, notifications and orders
made thereunder and in force immediately before the commencement of this Act
are adapted and shall, as far as practicable, be in force in Gilgit-Baltistan
subject to the following modifications, namely:
(a) the
expressions 'Government', 'Federal Government', 'President' or any other
expression howsoever worded, referring to any Executive Government, shall, as
far as practicable, be construed to refer to the Gilgit-Baltistan Council and
reference to Pakistan or any part of Pakistan shall be construed to refer to
Gilgit-Baltistan;
(b) the
expression 'Provincial Government' shall be construed to refer to the
Gilgit-Baltistan Government;
(c) the
expression "High Court shall be construed to refer to the Gilgit -Baltistan
Chief Court; and
(d) the
expression "Chief Justice" shall be construed to refer to the Chief
Judge, Gilgit-Baltistan Chief Court.

4. Previous
laws to cease to have effect.---If immediately before the coming into force
of this Act, there is in force in Gilgit-Baltistan any law corresponding to any
law adapted by this Act, it shall, subject to the other provisions of this Act,
cease to have effect on and from the date of the commencement of this Act:
Provided
that the provisions of this Act shall not render invalid anything duly done
before the commencement of this Act under the provisions of any previous law.
